title: archidendron poilanei
intro: Archidendron poilanei, commonly known as the Vietnamese ironwood, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including hypertension, diabetes, and gastrointestinal disorders, due to its health benefits such as lowering blood pressure and regulating blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Archidendron poilanei include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help in protecting against cell damage and reducing inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of Archidendron poilanei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
